en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a grand, multi‑storey Belle Époque hotel complex nestled at the base of a forested hillside. The large central building has many windows and dormer roofs, with a more ornate wing on the right featuring tall arched windows and decorative towers. In the foreground are glass-covered promenades or colonnades, terraces with tables and umbrellas, and people strolling in elegant early‑20th‑century attire. At the top in red text it reads "Karlsbad" on the left and "Grand Hôtel Pupp" on the right.
